integrity: The finite enumeration uses standard-library integer and string operations. All 720 permutations and 924 position partitions are exhausted for the order-six obstruction; no randomness, optimizer, or sampling establishes a theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact binary enumeration only for n=2,3,4,5,6; none of the claims extends to n>=7 or larger alphabets. The nine-word obstruction is sufficient only for its stated lower bound. No independent validation has been performed.
title: The first five binary permutation-covering numbers for shuffle squares
